references.text: Instructions regarding unclean persons who must be sent outside the camp, including those made unclean by contact with the dead.
The Nazirite shall not make himself unclean for a dead person, even for father, mother, brother, or sister - a parallel to the priest's restrictions.
Laws concerning uncleanness from touching a corpse and the required purification process.
The high priest has even stricter rules and may not make himself unclean even for his father or mother.
Ezekiel's vision regarding future priests and their rules for approaching the dead - only for close relatives.
Definition of close relatives (שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ) used in the same context.
